files.description: The primary EHI export documentation for 170.315(b)(10). A 2-page PDF describing the export format: C-CDA R2.1 for clinical data, CSV files for billing (claims, insurance payments, patient payments), raw document files, CSV for demographics/insurance, and CSV for future appointments. Covers both individual patient and population-level exports. No data dictionary or field-level definitions included.

ONC-required costs and considerations disclosure for certified functionality. Lists pricing for base EHR subscription, add-on modules (Direct messaging, EPCS, FHIR API, CDS, eLabs, eFax, etc.), and confirms FHIR API requires separate paid subscription. Relevant for understanding that EHI export and FHIR API are separate systems.

Full-page screenshot of the registered URL (costs and considerations page) showing certification information, MFA use cases, and the EHI Export Documentation section with the PDF download link. Captured via browser for visual record.
